name: Syns
description: Pull a Syns repository before every OpenClaw agent turn and sync it when the turn finishes, scoped to directories containing a .syns.yaml.

installIfMissing.description: Install the syns CLI via install.syns.dev on first use if it is not on PATH.

pullOnTurnStart.description: Run `syns pull --if-repo` before every agent turn (agent_turn_prepare).

syncOnTurnEnd.description: Run `syns sync --if-repo` when every agent turn finishes (before_agent_finalize, or agent_end where a runner never finalizes).

pushOnTurnEnd.description: Deprecated: the earlier name of syncOnTurnEnd, read only where that is unset.

cwd.description: Working directory to run syns in — the Syns repo path. Highest-priority cwd source; survives gateway restart (unlike the SYNS_CWD env var). Default: auto-detected.

synsBin.description: Path to the syns binary. Use an absolute path if syns is not on the gateway daemon's PATH.
